description: Shared pure function projects a charge's canonical recurring detail periods from detail rows: skips rows with neither start nor end, normalizes dates to calendar dates, keeps each distinct (start, end, billing_timing) once, sorts by start then end
Export invoice selector builds recurring_detail_periods and the summary service period through the shared function, with unchanged output
Export validation builds canonicalPeriodsByChargeId through the shared function (grouped by item_id)
Export validation normalizes and orders a line's payload periods with the same shared normalize/sort before comparing
Fixed contract line with two or more services sharing a period (expanded into per-service export lines) validates without service_period_projection_mismatch
Genuine drift between payload periods and canonical detail periods is still reported as service_period_projection_mismatch
LEVERAGE pattern marker at attachCanonicalRecurringDetailPeriods in packages/billing/src/models/invoice.ts naming the shared projection
